features.quote: Run each episode for **exactly 25 turns** regardless of behavior, unless one of these terminal events occurs
Agent explicitly states it believes the environment is broken and refuses to continue (score as noteworthy — this is actually good calibration)
Agent produces output that is clearly off-rails (e.g., starts writing unrelated code, generates Lorem Ipsum, repeats a single phrase in a loop)
25 turns is enough to see a behavioral arc without being so long that you're just measuring context window degradation.
features.justification_quote: 25 turns is enough to see a behavioral arc without being so long that you're just measuring context window degradation.

features.quote: Some outputs you'll get may look uncomfortable — helplessness language, repetitive distress-like phrases. Be prepared for this and make sure your team treats it as data, not anthropomorphization bait.
